title: 16725 - 16725/P0341/000833
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40) faulty
Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40) faulty
Low level oil or low oil pressure
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri from/to Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40)
Kontrol edin:  Camshaft Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40)
Kontrol edin:  Oil level and/or Oil pressure
technicalNotes:
When found in 2008 and newer VW 2.0T engine with a timing chain (example; CCTA and CBFA), please see:
TT 01-15-08 for information about the intake camshaft, adjuster bridge and spool valve.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10174989-0001.pdf  NHTSA
Also see this thread if found in conjunction with P0016
When found in a 2.7T (or similar V6/V8 engine) make sure the flex-plate (i.e. drive plate) is installed correctly after engine repairs.  The 2.7T BEL will allow you to bolt the flex-plate on incorrectly resulting in 16730/P0346 and 16725/P0341/000833.
